TCC Website Features 0.1.0: the church's own website features in one plugin

First version. Holds the event feeds, the Events filter bar, the event page banner, the older event date and venue lines, the sermon audio player and the forgiving menu hover, each with its own switch under TCC Website > Features. The code is the same as the Code Snippets snippets it replaces. Everything starts switched off, so installing it changes nothing until a feature is switched on.
